audit_items.proof_trace: The CEI pattern is correctly followed in all three implementations (LegionAbstractSale, LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale, LegionTokenDistributor): the guard (_verifyCanClaimTokenAllocation) reads hasSettled from storage and reverts if true, then hasSettled is set to true before any token transfers occur. hasSettled is never reset to false anywhere in the codebase, so the double-claim invariant is fully maintained even under reentrancy.
